description: This file contains the 'Information' model class for the OpenCart admin system, providing methods to manage information records (add, edit, delete, retrieve) in the catalog. It interacts with the database for storing and manipulating information entries including descriptions, stores, layouts, and SEO URLs.

classes.name: Information
classes.description: Model class for managing catalog information records, including creation, updating, deletion, and retrieval of information data, descriptions, store associations, layout configurations, and SEO URLs within the OpenCart admin system.

methods.name: addInformation
methods.description: Creates a new information record in the database, including descriptions, store relationships, SEO URLs, layouts, and cache invalidation.

methods.name: editInformation
methods.description: Updates an existing information record by its ID, including descriptions, store associations, SEO URLs, layouts, and cache invalidation.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Changes the status (enabled/disabled) of a specific information record.

methods.name: deleteInformation
methods.description: Removes an information record and its related descriptions, store links, layouts, SEO URLs, and cache entries.

methods.name: getInformation
methods.description: Retrieves a specific information record with its details.

methods.name: getInformations
methods.description: Fetches multiple information records based on filters, supports sorting, pagination, and caching.

methods.name: getTotalInformations
methods.description: Returns the total count of information records, optionally filtered.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description entry for a specific information ID and language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a given information ID.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes descriptions for a specific language across all information records.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions for a given information ID.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: addStore
methods.description: Associates an information record with a store.

methods.name: deleteStores
methods.description: Removes all store associations for a given information ID.

methods.name: deleteStoresByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes all information-store links for a specific store ID.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Retrieves store IDs associated with a specific information record.

methods.name: addLayout
methods.description: Assigns a layout to an information record for a specific store.

methods.name: deleteLayouts
methods.description: Deletes all layout associations for an information record.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Deletes layout associations by layout ID.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByStoreId
methods.description: Removes all layout associations for a specific store.

methods.name: getLayouts
methods.description: Retrieves layout IDs associated with an information record.

methods.name: getTotalLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Counts how many information records are linked with a specific layout.
